title: A Projected Tug-of-War Game for the Regularized $p$-Laplacian
summary: We give a tug-of-war interpretation of the regularized $p$-Laplacian $\operatorname{div}\big((1+|Dv|^2)^{p/2-1}Dv\big)=0$ in a bounded domain $Ω\subset \mathbb{R}^n$, $p\ge 2$. The key is the linear lift $w(x,x_{n+1})=v(x)+x_{n+1}$, which identifies this equation with $Δ_p w=0$ in $\mathbb{R}^n+1$.
